note: Every Texas product active on api.weather.gov/alerts/active?area=TX at capture time, verbatim except that description and instruction are cut to 240 characters and references are dropped. Six event types across all three tiers: Flash Flood Warning, Flood Warning (riverine, open-start VTEC), Flood Watch (KFWD 0007 arrives as two segments, EXT and EXB, sharing one VTEC tuple), Flood Advisory, Coastal Flood Advisory (one Louisiana and one Texas zone) and a High Wind Warning, the one non-flood standing product.
